units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 11:12">Ned. XI, 12</cite> <he>דרך ב׳</he> in the way of a request (to give a divorce, v. <cite ref="B01148">preced.</cite>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 9a:29">Ber. 9ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין נא אלא לשון ב׳</he> the word <cite ref="N00003"><he>נָא</he></cite> in the Bible means prayer (I pray &c.).
Ib. 57ᵃ תלויה בַקָּשָׁתוֹ his prayer is held in suspense (its fulfillment is doubtful).—בב׳ ממך I pray thee, v. בָּעוּ.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75">Gen. R. s. 75</cite> end; a. fr.—Pl. <he>בַּקָּשׁוֹת</he>
